title: 第46章 别怕，我在

第46章 别怕，我在-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

上一章

下一章

韩小溢的声音越来越远，估计是被周桂萍拖走了。

韩小汐有些颤抖地掏出手机。

居然正在通话中。

【沈珩……】出口便是带着哭腔的低语。

【别怕，我在。】沈珩尽量让自己的声音稳一点，【别说话，别暴露。】

他听得真切，【我已经报警了，而且，我很快会到。】

【啊？】韩小汐

原本打算一触即离，结果在她退开的刹那，男人的手心抵在她的后颈，又加深了这个吻。

“什么凤种嘛，还不就是一只鸡，要不是看在他主人的份上，我可不会那么轻易饶过他，非得拔了他一身毛不可。”秋生不满的低估了一句。

有些话说得已经够多，就没有必要再说了，那些事情只能顺其自然罢了。

连刘湘也担心，这么多伤兵，比钱更值钱，原计划水路运输一半回重庆，怕是不现实了。

Han Xiaoyi's voice became farther and farther away, and he was probably dragged away by Zhou Guiping.

Han Xiaoxi took out her mobile phone with some trembling.

Actually on the call.

[Shen Heng...] A cry-like whisper came out of his mouth.

[Don't be afraid, I'm here.] Shen Heng tried to keep his voice steady, [Don't talk, don't expose yourself.】

He heard it clearly, [I have already called the police, and I will be there soon.】

【ah?】Han Xiaoxi

She originally planned to leave at the first touch, but the moment she pulled away, the man's palm touched the back of her neck and deepened the kiss.

"What kind of phoenix? He's just a chicken. If it weren't for his master's sake, I wouldn't let him go so easily. I would have to pluck all of his hair." Qiu Sheng underestimated with dissatisfaction.

Some things have been said enough and there is no need to say them anymore. Those things can only be allowed to take their course.

Even Liu Xiang was worried that so many wounded soldiers were worth more than money. The original plan to transport half of them back to Chongqing by water was probably unrealistic.
